title: Great App
body: I love the layout and how simple it looks. Yet it’s still powerful and can connects to Apple Health.
author: Andri Agassi

title: Not good for Pills
body:
And doesn’t support Russian UI

I mean that your application does not synchronize between devices, making it inconvenient to track medication intake across different schedules.

And I’m not a fool to accept template answers! I already understand how synchronization works, and with such a response, you are attempting to shift the responsibility onto the user, assuming they won’t respond and that everyone will think they used the app incorrectly. The issue is on your side, and I’m not a tester on your payroll — test and fix it yourselves; I have already pointed out the problem.
author: Rammzes2
